_meta.title: The First Apex Predator Had No Teeth
_meta.format: wordless vertical Short, Primeval Atlas style
_meta.narration: NONE - wordless. Grok native clip audio + free music bed only.
_meta.pipeline: ChatGPT image (9:16 still) -> Grok Imagine i2v (video+audio) -> ffmpeg assemble
_meta.hook: WORLD -> REVEAL: a dark seafloor ridge that turns out to be an animal
_meta.rule: what you read as seafloor is alive - taught at 0:07, repeated as the bookend at 0:55
_meta.accuracy_note: Dunkleosteus had NO true teeth. Its bite came from two self-sharpening bony gnathal plates that honed against each other. This is the title's payoff and it is scientifically correct.
_meta.style_suffix: photorealistic underwater natural history documentary still, shot on a cinema camera, cold dark teal-green Devonian ocean, single soft light source from directly above, heavy volumetric god-rays, suspended silt and marine snow, shallow depth of field, no text, no watermark, no people, vertical 9:16 composition
_meta.negative: cartoon, illustration, CGI game render, text, watermark, logo, human, diver, modern coral reef, bright tropical colours, distorted anatomy, extra fins, six eyes

colour_worlds.act1_gloom: very desaturated, near-monochrome dark teal, low key, 20-30% saturation
colour_worlds.act2_hunt: saturated blue-cyan, bright god-rays from above, 60-75% saturation

shots.beat: WORLD - the puzzle. Reads as terrain, not an animal.
shots.still_prompt: Wide shot of a dark Devonian seafloor, a long low armoured ridge of grey-green bony plates half buried in silt, indistinguishable from rock, a few small primitive fish drifting past it, cold teal gloom, god-rays from far above
shots.i2v_prompt: the small fish drift slowly past, silt particles drift, the ridge does not move at all, camera perfectly still

shots.beat: REVEAL - the terrain opens. This is the hook payoff.
shots.still_prompt: The armoured ridge on the seafloor is revealed to be the head of an enormous placoderm fish, bony plates parting to show a dark mouth, silt sliding off the armour, cold teal gloom
shots.i2v_prompt: the bony head lifts off the seafloor and the jaws crack open once, silt slides off the armour and clouds outward, the small fish scatter

shots.beat: THE MACHINE - macro on the bony shears. Pays off the title.
shots.still_prompt: Extreme macro of two interlocking blades of bone inside the mouth of an armoured placoderm, no teeth anywhere, self-sharpened bone edges honed like shears, a single hard glint travelling along the cutting edge, cold dark water
shots.i2v_prompt: the bony blades slide past each other once and shut hard, a glint races along the cutting edge, particles jolt outward

shots.beat: SCALE - the whole animal, low angle, dominant.
shots.still_prompt: Low angle looking up at the full body of a giant armoured Dunkleosteus lifting off the seabed, heavy bony head plates, thick muscular body, silhouetted against faint light from the surface far above, cold teal gloom
shots.i2v_prompt: the huge fish rises slowly off the bottom and glides forward over the camera, unhurried, powerful tail beat

shots.beat: ACT BREAK - colour opens up. The reward act.
shots.still_prompt: Open Devonian water column, bright shafts of light from the surface, a dense silver school of small primitive fish above, the dark armoured shape of a large placoderm cruising below them, saturated blue-cyan, marine snow
shots.i2v_prompt: the school of fish wheels and turns together, the dark armoured shape cruises slowly beneath them, light shafts sway

shots.beat: THE OTHER ANIMAL - a rival enters. Tension.
shots.still_prompt: A sleek primitive shark with long pointed fins crossing through bright shafts of light in open blue Devonian water, seen from below, a much larger dark armoured shape barely visible in the blue haze behind it
shots.i2v_prompt: the sleek shark glides across frame through the light shafts, and the huge dark shape behind it slowly turns toward it

shots.beat: CONTACT - staged DARK, fast and occluded. i2v cannot do clean contact.
shots.still_prompt: A violent underwater strike in low light, an enormous armoured bony head lunging from below into a burst of silt and bubbles, the prey almost completely hidden inside the churning cloud, very dark, heavy motion blur, only a hard edge of bone catching light
shots.i2v_prompt: the armoured head lunges up into frame and the water explodes into silt and bubbles, everything churns, very fast, dark

shots.beat: AFTERMATH - the longest hold, on a shot that renders well (drifting debris).
shots.still_prompt: Slowly settling cloud of silt and drifting scales in dim green-brown water after a kill, small fragments turning in the current, the dark bulk of a large armoured fish barely visible inside the murk, desaturated
shots.i2v_prompt: the silt cloud slowly billows and settles, scales and fragments drift down through the water, the dark bulk moves once inside the murk

shots.beat: BOOKEND - it settles back and becomes 'rock' again. Rhymes with S01.
shots.still_prompt: A huge armoured placoderm settling back down onto a silty Devonian seabed, silt drifting over its bony plates until it reads as a low ridge of rock again, small fish returning to drift past it, cold teal gloom, wide shot
shots.i2v_prompt: the animal settles onto the seabed and goes completely still, silt drifts over and across it, small fish drift back into frame, camera perfectly still
